module mg_02478(clock,reset,button,button_pressed);
parameter Wait = 40000; 
  parameter Size = 16; 
  input wire clock; 
  input wire reset; 
  input wire button; 
  output wire button_pressed; 
  reg [Size-1:0] s_Counter; 
  reg s_DoneCount; 
  reg s_ButtonPressed; 
  assign button_pressed = s_ButtonPressed; 
  always @ (posedge clock) begin 
  if (reset) begin 
  s_Counter <= 0; 
  s_DoneCount <= 0; 
  s_ButtonPressed <= 0; 
  end 
  else begin 
  if (button) begin 
  if (!s_DoneCount) begin 
  if (s_Counter < Wait) begin 
  s_Counter <= s_Counter + 1; 
  s_DoneCount <= 0; 
  s_ButtonPressed <= 0; 
  end 
  else begin 
  s_Counter <= 0; 
  s_DoneCount <= 1; 
  s_ButtonPressed <= 1; 
  end 
  end 
  else begin 
  s_Counter <= 0; 
  s_DoneCount <= 1; 
  s_ButtonPressed <= 0; 
  end 
  end 
  else begin 
  s_Counter <= 0; 
  s_DoneCount <= 0; 
  s_ButtonPressed <= 0; 
  end 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
